title: Customer linking and notification choices
decision: Consent is asked before the waiting entry is stored, which is stricter than BR-16; customer_link.waiting_name holds the Telegram profile name only while a person waits; the counter code is revealed once when a manager or owner issues it, and sellers use personal links; personal links last 7 days; a chosen promised date is sent as a second short message; staff are not told in chat that someone is waiting; five SECURITY DEFINER functions carry the customer's steps across the tenant boundary; the Russian consent text is an agent draft
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 21
rationale: A customer is not a member of the shop, so their steps cannot run under the shop's row-level security. Only the hash of a code is stored, so a code cannot be shown again; a manager can issue a new one
